messages:
alex: Quick q — for the SDK surface: should the resume token be an opaque string or a typed object with metadata? I'm worried about retries and transport handoffs.
maria: my vote: opaque string for stability across clients, but expose helper parser for languages that want typed views.
sam: +1 opaque for wire. For Python/TS we can offer a typed wrapper but not required. Go? prefer concrete type for compile-time safety.
jin: Go typed wrapper could be in a separate module pkg/token so we don't bloat core.
olivia: How do we handle retries & idempotency if token hides state? need explicit flags: is_replayable / nonce in token metadata?
alex: idea: token = base64(json({cursor, version, hints})) on the wire. SDKs can parse safely. transport should treat it opaque.
sam: that works. But careful: embedding hints in token makes it harder to evolve schema. include a version byte + optional TLV.
maria: TLV + version sounds good. Then SDK parser can ignore unknown TLVs. Backwards compatible.
jin: Agree. Also need to decide whether retry should replay on different transport (http -> grpc). transport layer must not assume resume token semantics.
olivia: Implementation notes: SDK surface should provide two helpers: 1) ResumeToken.parse() -> typed view (opt-in) 2) Client.resume_with_token(token) keeps token opaque by default.
alex: UX: Python/TS convenience: expose token.hints() for prefetch guidance, but default clients must not rely on hints for correctness.
sam: Edge-case: partial read + retry. We need server to return a stable resume token immediately after each successful page, and clients must checkpoint last_successful_token before processing body.
olivia: We should update the migration doc: add 'token-versioning' section and example code in py/ts/go repos.
build-bot: deploy scheduled: merge branch token-versioning into main at 1700002000 :rocket: 
alex: Want to capture action items: maria -> draft token TLV spec, jin -> pkg/token in go, sam -> add parser in TS, olivia -> docs/examples, i'll own client surface PR. ok?
maria: on it, will ping with a short RFC follow-up.
sam: I'll stub TS types this afternoon.
jin: Starting go package tomorrow.
olivia: I'll add example code snippets to the SDK migration guide.
alex: cool — keeping token opaque by default, optional typed helpers, TLV+version for extensibility. thanks :thumbsup:
